stem.en: Which of these does the ECI allot to a recognised national or State party?

text.en: Votes that each count for more than other parties' votes
A candidate on every ballot in India
A sure seat in the Lok Sabha

explanation.en: The ECI allots election symbols to national and State parties. Every vote still counts the same, a party stands only where it puts up candidates, and it must still win its seats.

hints.en: Think of what the ECI allots to national and State parties.
